Crayon Kingdom Cast

A sticker album from

The Crayon Kingdom

Every character in this book was drawn by hand by Zoey, in marker and crayon, and every one of them is about to star in a video game. Tap any card to see their special move.

Drawn by hand by Zoey Fun for all ages

The story so far

One rainy afternoon a giant blob of ink spilled across the Crayon Kingdom. Out of the splat crawled the Scribble Squad, who scribbled over the colours and trapped the kingdom's friends inside inky bubbles. Now a team of heroes has to jump, flutter, dash and draw their way through the Meadow, the Sunny Sand Hills and the Rainbow Swirl to rescue everyone and put the colour back. And somewhere in the middle of all this, a very large ladybird has moved in.
